properties.name: Nova music festival (near Re'im)
properties.detail: Open-air music festival attacked at dawn; about 364 people were killed here and dozens abducted — the deadliest single site of the attack.

properties.name: Kibbutz Be'eri
properties.detail: About 100 residents were killed and roughly 30 taken hostage when the kibbutz was overrun.

properties.name: Kibbutz Kfar Aza
properties.detail: About 60 residents were killed and around 19 abducted in the assault on the kibbutz.

properties.name: Kibbutz Nir Oz
properties.detail: Roughly one in four residents was killed or abducted — about 47 killed and more than 70 taken hostage.

properties.name: Sderot
properties.detail: Gunmen seized the city's police station; about 70 people were killed in Sderot, including some 20 police officers.

properties.name: Nahal Oz base and kibbutz
properties.detail: The IDF border post was overrun — more than 50 soldiers were killed, including many of the base's young female surveillance soldiers, and others captured.

properties.name: Netiv HaAsara
properties.detail: The moshav closest to the Gaza fence; about 20 residents were killed by infiltrators who crossed with paragliders and breached the barrier.
